item.case_name: Perfume and two people in four seasons, 20 s, 9:16, one reference
item.title: Perfume and two people, four seasons

turns.text:
Make a 20-second vertical 9:16 perfume ad in four seasons with two people. Use the attached bottle photo: keep the bottle's shape, cap and the MOCKUP FRAGRANCE letters the same in every shot, and leave the box out.

Mara: a woman in her thirties with short curly red hair, round gold glasses and a mustard-yellow wool coat.
Theo: a tall man in his sixties with a white beard, a navy flat cap and a long grey scarf.
Keep each of them looking the same every time they appear.

Four shots of 5 seconds each, in this order:
1. Spring: Mara stands under a cherry tree in blossom and holds the bottle up near her face as pink petals fall.
2. Summer: Theo stands on a bright beach at the edge of the waves and holds the bottle in his open hand.
3. Autumn: Theo sits on a park bench among red and orange leaves and sprays the perfume once on his wrist.
4. Winter: Mara stands in falling snow, holds the bottle against her coat and smiles.

No text on screen, no sound. Give me one finished video file.

Mara looks the same in spring and winter
Theo looks the same in summer and autumn
No season is left in the next season's frames
